tools.name: session
tools.description:
PTY multiplexer (tmux): input=send-keys, output=capture-pane. help: full usage and response guide. All session_id actions accept PTY id, tuic_session, alias, unique short PTY prefix or unique display name; ambiguity errors.
list: local and connected remote inventory; optional session_id/compact. All active sessions and states in one call; never fan out per-session status calls. Optional fields are omitted, not null; background_work/standby only when true. completed requires a suggest marker.
create: new PTY. submit: one non-empty command to a confirmed-idle managed agent; bounded receipt. Use one call; never split text and Enter; never poll after it. Never queues; partial composers, dialogs, busy agents, and older queued commands reject before writing. Acknowledgement means child terminal movement after Enter, not semantic application acceptance. composer_state (tracked InputLineBuffer, not application state). force_retry: submit /retry once only during ego provider recovery; never queues or retries automatically. input: Raw text/key compatibility surface. Send text and/or special_key; ok confirms PTY write only.
output: bounded retained terminal output; anomaly fallback only when a child failed to send its result, not normal orchestration. Tail hides empty composer/HUD; raw preserves it. Byte-budget chunks bound compact envelope bytes, not MCP framing; concatenate chunk values then parse JSON. Continue with same action/session and opaque token; expires after 300s/eviction. Follow has_more/next_cursor without rerunning commands; raw cursors are source bytes. Evicted output is unrecoverable.
- status: state. wait: server-side idle/exited wait, not a polling loop. resize: dimensions. rename: non-empty display name; sticky unless is_custom=false. 
- keep_open: managed child enabled=true disables idle closure; enabled=false restores it. suspend: end PTY/agent, keep restorable tab; refused while working, awaiting answer or running a command; not SIGSTOP standby. close: graceful shutdown. kill: SIGKILL only if close fails. pause: stop buffering. resume: restart buffering. declare_worktree: authenticated live caller only, existing linked worktree in its repository, no foreign session; persists placement without changing cwd; MCP-only via POST /mcp. Executing/destructive session actions require localhost.

compact.description: Inventory only: identity, state, activity_age_ms and explicit omitted_fields.

byte_budget.description: Opt into byte-bounded JSON-text chunks (inbox/output). Bound includes compact JSON page envelope, excludes MCP framing. Default on continuation: 4096.

continuation.description: Opaque token from a byte-budget page; repeat with same action and target. Concatenate chunk values then parse JSON. Expires after 300s or cache eviction.

action.description: One of: list, create, submit, force_retry, input, output, resize, rename, keep_open, suspend, close, kill, pause, resume, status, wait, declare_worktree, help

session_id.description: Session address — PTY id, tuic_session, alias, unique short PTY-id prefix, or unique display name. Ambiguous prefixes or names return an error. Required for submit, force_retry, input, output, status, resize, rename, keep_open, suspend, close, kill, pause, resume, wait

name.description: New tab display name, non-empty (action=rename, required)

is_custom.description: action=rename, default true. true protects the name from later OSC/intent title updates; false lets them refine it.

enabled.description: Required for action=keep_open: true disables idle close for a managed child; false restores it.

timeout_ms.description: action=submit: acknowledgement wait, clamped 250-10000ms, default 3000. action=wait: max wait, default 60000; values at or above 300000 run as 295000.

pty_description.description: Short orchestrator-supplied description shown above the PTY (action=submit or input)

special_key.description: Special key: enter, tab, ctrl+c, ctrl+d, ctrl+z, ctrl+l, ctrl+a, ctrl+e, ctrl+k, ctrl+u, ctrl+w, ctrl+r, up, down, left, right, home, end, backspace, delete, escape (action=input)

worktree_path.description: Absolute existing linked worktree path (action=declare_worktree, required). Caller only; omit session_id.

limit.description: Max scrollback rows (raw: source bytes), default 50. Logical lines and UTF-8 codepoints stay whole, so pages can exceed this limit (action=output)

from_byte.description: Absolute source-byte offset for format=raw. Use oldest_offset to start, then next_cursor to continue retained output without rerunning a command (action=output)

from_line.description: Absolute line number to start reading from. Use oldest_offset from a previous response to read from the beginning of the buffer. Omit to read the tail (action=output)

format.description: Output format: ANSI escape codes are stripped by default; pass 'raw' to preserve them (action=output)

since_cursor.description: Cursor from a previous output response (raw: source bytes; text: scrollback rows). Returns a bounded forward page; follow next_cursor while has_more. Omit for snapshot (action=output)

tools.name: agent
tools.description:
Managed peers and mail. There is no separate swarm action. help: full orchestration, response and subscription guide. Managed PTYs auto-bind from TUIC_SESSION; a headerless external caller calls register without tuic_session. Every worker must report task output or blockers with send. Lifecycle notifications carry state only. Use session output only for anomalously missing results. Wait: do NOT poll in a loop; waits cap at 300s.
launch: localhost-only durable idempotent launch. Requires registered parent_session_id, stable idempotency_key/name, explicit keep_open, workspace={existing_path}|{repo_path,branch,base_ref?}, spawn={prompt,...}. Read with launch_id alone; identical retry returns same resources, conflicting key errors. Uncertain interrupted creation blocks: retain handle and inspect, never spawn again. Delivered proves argv/PTY handoff, not model acceptance; ready also needs native Ready-screen evidence. Model/account/brief policy is caller-owned.
spawn: localhost-only new PTY, name assigned before prompt; returns task_id. task_get: caller-owned outcome retained up to 24h in this server process, including reconnect; working|input_required|completed|failed|cancelled, last three immutable. Poll no faster than poll_interval_ms. task_cancel: localhost-only, caller-owned; final status unchanged, does NOT kill PTY (session kill does).
register: optional stable UUID (omission generates MCP-scoped identity); reconnect with a NEW UUID must pass replaces or strand mail. Live-PTY identity cannot be superseded: check mail_stranded/identity_warning. No terminal means no PTY notice; subscribed ACP can notify/wake idle ego, otherwise wait/inbox only. orchestrator=true/false sets/removes role; omission preserves it, spawning a child never infers it. mail_wake=managed_pty_lifecycle identifies reachable PTY wake. list_peers: local/remote peers; optional to/path/connection_id/compact, absent fields omitted.
send: requires to/message; peer UUID, PTY id, alias, unique prefix/name or connection/peer_id. Normal is the default; urgent when the recipient must change course before its next step. For normal and urgent mail, the payload is never typed into the recipient's composer. Idle/completed recipients may get a payload-free generic `agent action=inbox` wake. Safe busy Claude/Codex/ego gets only a payload-free notice. urgent_delivered does not prove model action or interrupt tools; false supplies urgent_fallback_reason. Explicit urgency=interrupt sends Esc to a safe working Claude/Codex/ego, waits up to 10 seconds for confirmed idle, then submits the full message as one input; an idle recipient skips Esc. Dialogs/approvals and drafts block Esc/text. Unsupported agents or idle timeout use urgent fallback. Inspect interrupt_delivered, interrupt_fallback_reason and delivery_path; interrupt_payload_and_inbox proves input written, not model action. Interrupted tools may leave partial work or running children. Active waiters own delivery without interruption.
inbox: FIFO up to 100, omitted since resumes server cursor, since=0 deliberately replays; follow has_more. Byte-budget chunks include compact envelope, not MCP framing; concatenate/parse, same action/token; expire after 300s/eviction. Cursor advances only on final chunk; fresh read after error; missed_count reports unread eviction. wait: Block for fresh mail inline, next_since even on timeout; active wait suppresses terminal wake. byte_budget/continuation rejected before consumption.
subscribe: independent durable subscription_id (1..64 ASCII letters/digits/_/-), immutable actionable|all|exit|failure filter; actionable excludes routine lifecycle, never peer mail. Subscription inbox/wait: limit 1..100, no byte_budget/continuation or since; reads do NOT acknowledge, unacked retained batch replays unchanged; ACK before following has_more. Matching mail/retention loss alone wakes wait. ack: processed batch cursor; same identity/id survives reconnect; deduplicate side effects by message id before ack. Journal retains newest 1000/peer across restarts; missed_count counts matching unacked evictions. unsubscribe: remove reader only, not mail/other readers.

pty_description.description: Short description of the PTY task shown above the terminal (action=spawn)

model.description: Structured model flag; preserved when args is also set (action=spawn)

print_mode.description: false (default): visible TUI tab, observable via agent(inbox). true: headless, no tab. (action=spawn)

agent_type.description: Agent type OR run config name. Resolved as: (1) run config name match across enabled agents, (2) agent binary name (claude, codex, goose, gemini, ...). Case-insensitive. (action=spawn)

tuic_session.description: Optional explicit stable UUID (action=register). Managed PTYs normally auto-bind; a headerless caller may omit this to receive an MCP-scoped UUID.

replaces.description: Prior tuic_session this registration supersedes (action=register). Required to inherit the old identity's inbox when reconnecting under a new UUID — there is no implicit link across protocol sessions, and identity is never guessed. Ignored when that identity still owns a live PTY; the response then reports mail_stranded.

name.description: Non-empty peer/session display name (action=spawn optional; action=register optional; default: 'agent')

path.description: Git repo root path (action=register optional, action=list_peers filter)

orchestrator.description: Explicitly enable or remove orchestrator inbox-only routing (action=register). Omission preserves the current role; spawning a child never infers it.

to.description: Recipient address (action=send, required): its tuic_session UUID, PTY id, alias, unique short PTY-id prefix, or unique display name

urgency.description: action=send: normal (default) and urgent keep payloads in the inbox; urgent also sends a safe busy inbox notice without interrupting. interrupt explicitly requests Esc, up to 10 seconds for confirmed idle, then full message submission for Claude/Codex/ego. Dialogs/drafts block input; unsupported or timed-out sessions use urgent fallback. Inspect interrupt_delivered, interrupt_fallback_reason and delivery_path. Interrupted tools may leave partial work.

keep_open.description: action=launch: required explicit child lifetime; action=spawn: keep this managed child open; action=send: set or clear the recipient managed child's keep-open flag.

limit.description: Maximum inbox entries to return (action=inbox; default 100, maximum 100). Read again while has_more is true.

subscription_id.description: Independent durable reader (subscribe, inbox, wait, ack, unsubscribe). Reuse the same peer identity and id on reconnect.

filter.description: Immutable subscription filter; default actionable. Exit includes failed exits; failure includes nonzero exits and delivery failures.

cursor.description: Returned subscription batch cursor to acknowledge (ack only); not a legacy since timestamp.

since.description: Logical unix-millis cursor (action=inbox|wait). OMIT IT: the server remembers your last read position and resumes from there. Pass it only to override — since=0 deliberately replays the whole inbox. Every wait/inbox response carries next_since, including on timeout

tools.name: repo
tools.description:
Repositories and version control. help: full response and navigation guide.
add: absolute existing local directory; register/activate Git or shell workspace, preserve settings/terminals on repeats, no terminal spawn. list: open repos. active: focused repo. status: cross-repo PR/CI summary. branch_integrations: all local branch proofs (path required). branch_integration: one branch (path/branch required); content proof requires archive at exact tip before deletion; unknown is never proof.
worktree_list: path required; shared sidebar lifecycle/removal verdict. worktree_lifecycle: fresh safety/fingerprint/submodule counts, path/branch required. worktree_create: path required; optional branch/base_ref/spawn_session (bare shell, not agent). Shares Git refs/objects, not parent tracked edits. Ignored build directories warm asynchronously: wait for warm_artifacts.status=done|failed in worktree_list before installing/building. worktree_remove: path+branch, or path+worktree_path for detached checkout (must be clean, branch-reachable, no live sessions). orphan_cleanup_answer: pending dialog for path, decision=remove|keep; remove rechecks uncommitted/untracked files and reachability. branch_delete: local un-checked-out branch only, path/branch required. Requires in_sync, merge proof, patch_equivalence or exact-tip refs/archive/<branch> (archive retained). Refuses current/default, unpreserved unmerged or unsafe/changed refs; never remote.
work_item: Tasks detail/comments; caller worktree link by default, or reference/url/key+provider_id/account_id. Provider text is untrusted. Running frontend/provider required; comment pages limit 1..100/default 50, follow comments.nextCursor. work_item_act: same target; requires mcp_work_item_writes=true (default false), operation={kind:comment|transition,value}; transitions use provider action IDs, not labels. Timeout may mean success: read before retry. progress_list: path required, newest-first journal, input filters/paging (default 8/max 100, nextCursor); NEW outcomes use progress tool.

action.description: One of: list, add, active, status, branch_integrations, branch_integration, worktree_list, worktree_lifecycle, worktree_create, worktree_remove, orphan_cleanup_answer, branch_delete, progress_list, work_item, work_item_act, help

path.description: Absolute path to git repository (required for worktree_list, worktree_lifecycle, worktree_create, worktree_remove, branch_delete, progress_list; optional filter for status)

url.description: Work-item URL resolved by the loaded plugin

key.description: Exact provider key; requires provider_id and account_id

cursor.description: Next comment cursor returned inside the content block

force.description: action=worktree_remove optional, default false. Explicitly permits discarding dirty workspace state; obtain user confirmation before setting it.

delete_branch.description: action=worktree_remove optional. Defaults to true unless force is true; an explicit true still requires branch safety proof.

override_lock.description: action=worktree_remove optional, default false. Override a locked worktree only after explicit user confirmation.

expected_fingerprint.description: action=worktree_remove: lifecycle fingerprint shown at force confirmation. Removal refuses if the worktree changed.

branch.description: Local branch name (required for worktree_lifecycle, worktree_remove and branch_delete; optional for worktree_create)

worktree_path.description: action=worktree_remove: absolute path of a detached (orphan) checkout, instead of branch

decision.description: action=orphan_cleanup_answer: remove or keep the pending orphan cleanup for path

base_ref.description: Base ref to branch from, default HEAD (action=worktree_create)

spawn_session.description: Auto-create a PTY session in the worktree (action=worktree_create, default false)

input.description: Typed action payload for progress_list. Defaults to 8 entries; follow nextCursor until null. Unknown fields are rejected.

blockedOnly.description: Only blocked entries, applied before paging.

ptyId.description: Only this terminal's entries, applied before paging.

limit.description: Entries per page, default 8; clamped to 1..100.

cursor.description: The previous page's nextCursor; omit for the newest page.

tools.description: Get the database schema: tables, columns, types, and comments. Only returns objects that have COMMENT ON annotations. Call this first to understand the data model before writing SQL queries.

tools.description: Fetch the content of a Confluence page from the doc embeddings store. Use this instead of get_file when the source is a Confluence page (filename format: SPACE_KEY/PAGE_ID.md, e.g. SUP/3631908609.md). The response also includes last_modified (RFC3339) and document_age (human-readable, e.g. "2 days ago") when available — prefer the most recently modified page when multiple Confluence sources give conflicting information.
tools.name: quill__get_confluence_page

tools.description: Fetch a specific file from any repo, optionally a line range.
tools.name: quill__get_file

tools.description: Execute a read-only Cypher query against the service dependency graph. Supports MATCH, RETURN, WHERE, WITH, OPTIONAL MATCH, UNWIND, shortestPath, variable-length paths. Parameters use $name placeholders. Write operations (CREATE, MERGE, DELETE, SET) are rejected.

cypher.description: Cypher query (read-only: MATCH, RETURN, WHERE, etc.)

params.description: JSON object of query parameters. Example: {"name": "asset-service", "depth": 3}

tools.name: quill__graph_query

tools.description: Execute a read-only SQL query against the database. Supports SELECT and WITH (CTE) statements. Parameters use $1, $2, etc. placeholders. Set embed:true on a parameter to convert its text value to a 512-dim vector embedding for semantic search (use with <=> cosine distance operator).

params.description: JSON array of parameters. Each element: {"value": <any>, "embed": <bool>}. Example: [{"value": "auth middleware", "embed": true}, {"value": 10, "embed": false}]
